title: Shrinkage Bayesian Causal Forest with Instrumental Variable
abstract: arXiv:2609.18903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discovering interpretable subgroups whose complier effects deviate from the average is a central goal of instrumental variable analysis under imperfect compliance, yet existing tree-based methods degrade when most covariates are irrelevant to the effect. We propose Shrinkage Bayesian Causal Forest with Instrumental Variable (SBCF-IV) for discovering and estimating subgroups with heterogeneous Complier Average Causal Effects (CACE) in sparse high-dimensional settings. SBCF-IV places a sparsity-inducing Dirichlet prior on the splitting probabilities of the Bayesian Additive Regression Trees that estimate the conditional intention-to-treat and the complier share, concentrating posterior mass on the few covariates that moderate the complier effect and thereby regularizing effect estimation. translated_title: 带工具变量的收缩贝叶斯因果森林
translated_abstract: 在不完全依从的情况下，发现依从者效应偏离平均值的可解释子群是工具变量分析的核心目标，然而当大多数协变量与效应无关时，现有的基于树的方法性能会下降。我们提出了带工具变量的收缩贝叶斯因果森林（SBCF-IV），用于在稀疏高维设置中发现和估计具有异质性依从者平均因果效应（CACE）的子群。SBCF-IV在估计条件意向处理效应和依从者比例的贝叶斯可加回归树的分裂概率上施加了诱导稀疏性的狄利克雷先验，将后验质量集中在少数调节依从者效应的协变量上，从而正则化效应估计。后验分裂频率还作为变量级别的代价进入下游的CART，引导分区朝向相关的调节变量……
tldr: 该论文提出SBCF-IV方法，通过在贝叶斯可加回归树的分裂概率上施加稀疏性狄利克雷先验，在稀疏高维设置下有效发现并估计具有异质性依从者平均因果效应的子群。
